content: NixOS/nixpkgs release EOL (HIGH, nixos.org blog 2026-05-30 + STACK.md): stable branches supported ~7 months; 25.05 'Warbler' EOL 2025-12-31 (no security updates); 25.11 'Xantusia' EOL 2026-06-30; 26.05 'Yarara' released 2026-05-30, supported until 2026-12-31; 26.11 next. Pinning an EOL branch ships known-vulnerable packages with no binary-cache guarantee. Home Manager upgrading.md (HIGH): HM release branches follow NixOS releases - use release-<version> matching your nixpkgs branch; master tracks nixpkgs-unstable; mismatch triggers explicit warning 'You are using Home Manager version X and Nixpkgs version Y. Using mismatched versions is likely to cause errors' (home.enableNixpkgsReleaseCheck, do not disable casually). Community reports: HM master (25.11-pre style) against older stable nixpkgs = warning + breakage risk; deployment-repo HM 25.11-pre CLI vs flake-pinned release-26.05 module can mismatch - bootstrap with 'nix run home-manager/release-26.05 -- switch --flake .#<host>' to avoid depending on the locally installed CLI.
